reading.calculation: Valid: the reported numerical checks converged.

pipes.rule: the best-insulated commercial pipe for which a flow passes, tried in this order: TK-Drakon coated, internally coated, externally coated, conventional
pipes.rule_source: pipe conductivities from Wu et al. (2025) and Vetsak et al. (2024); the TK-Drakon coating from NOV's product flyer (2024)

mass_flow_kg_s.rule: the lowest flow on the grid that keeps the tool below its limit and cleans the hole within the pump limit

volume_flow_L_s.rule: the same search; a volume flow is at surface, at the fluid's density at 20 C

mass_flows_kg_s.rule: the model's flow grid, 5 to 50 in steps of 5 and then 60 to 100 in steps of 10, is read as kg/s while the fluid is water, which it is in the first fluid pass, and as L/s at surface once the fluid is weighted; a stated grid keeps its own unit in every pass, so stating these numbers does not reproduce the default result

volume_flows_L_s.rule: the model's flow grid, 5 to 50 in steps of 5 and then 60 to 100 in steps of 10, is read as kg/s while the fluid is water, which it is in the first fluid pass, and as L/s at surface once the fluid is weighted; a stated grid keeps its own unit in every pass, so stating these numbers does not reproduce the default result

tool_limit_C.rule: 200 C, the rating of the high-temperature commercial tool class
tool_limit_C.rule_source: the model's downhole electronics classes: about 150 to 175 C for conventional MWD and LWD tools, about 200 C for high-temperature tools

coating_ratings_C.rule: TK-Drakon coated 204 C, the coating maker's rating, given while circulation is maintained; other pipes have no rating
coating_ratings_C.rule_source: NOV Tuboscope TK-Drakon flyer D392006697-MKT-001 Rev 01 (2024)

pump_pressure_limit_Pa.rule: 51.7 MPa, from the reference design's 7,500 psi
pump_pressure_limit_Pa.rule_source: the reference well design of Wu et al. (2025)

rig_pumps.rule: 3 pumps, each an NOV 14-P-220 giving 1,980 hydraulic hp, up to 7,475 psi on 5.5-inch liners
rig_pumps.rule_source: NOV 14-P-220 mud pump technical marketing sheet; the pump count from the FORGE 16B daily reports

min_annular_velocity_m_s.rule: 1.245 m/s, the annular velocity around the drill pipe at FORGE 16B at 600 US gal/min (245.1 ft/min)
min_annular_velocity_m_s.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

precirculation_min.rule: 0.33 min, the 10th percentile of circulation after the last new hole at FORGE 16B; a stated value ends the schedule search
precirculation_min.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

connection_median_min.rule: 2.83 min, the median FORGE 16B connection with the pumps off
connection_median_min.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

connection_p90_min.rule: 6.33 min, the 90th-percentile FORGE 16B connection with the pumps off; a stated value ends the schedule search
connection_p90_min.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

trip_hours.rule: 43.806 h at the target depth, from FORGE 16B tripping speeds of 1,694 ft/h out and 1,833 ft/h in, with 3.93 h at surface
trip_hours.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

trip_scale.rule: 1, no factor on the trip-time rule
trip_scale.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

stage_spacing_m.rule: 144.9 m (475 ft), the FORGE 16B staging interval; a stated value ends the staging search
stage_spacing_m.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

stage_minutes.rule: 15.51 min, the FORGE 16B stage circulation; a stated value ends the staging search
stage_minutes.rule_source: Utah FORGE well 16B drilling data, May 2023 (Geothermal Data Repository submission 1516)

rop_m_h.rule: Model 3 at the circulation, iterated with the wall's exposure for a coupled site

drilling_fluid_kg_m3.rule: the lower bound of the drilling fluid's common window, never below water, iterated with the circulation

trip_fluid_kg_m3.rule: the larger of the drilling fluid and the lower bound of the trip fluid's common window
